mapper.select: SELECT id, role, content, created_at FROM mf_ai_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, role, content, created_at FROM mf_ai_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mf_ai_message (user_id, conversation_id, role, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mf_ai_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
